notes.title: 0.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33146644/20379e0317b70ef9770d643517670f31af46a210.png
Hey everyone! 0.3.1 is a small update with some minor bug fixes and some tweaks to the inventory. Save files from 0.1.2 onward have been tested and are compatible.

Bug Fixes

Sound Menu being unable to be closed in certain situations is fixed
“Are You Sure?” and “Save First” prompts in Tutorial fixed
If “Loot Box Opening Sounds” was saved as off, it will now load that correctly


Patch Notes

Default selected item in Inventory is now your currently selected item
Inventory code optimized to be more efficient

notes.title: 0.3.0.1 Update
notes.notes: Some players reported issues loading old savefiles on 0.3.0. This was a tiny patch to resolve that issue. Apologies for the disruption in your loot box opening. More rigorous savefile tests will be performed before pushing future updates.

notes.title: Beta 0.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33146644/931acf2d03d588b02cdbda8ef64bc42f683d5fee.png
As a thank you to Steam user A.M. for finding a bug with our fragment conversion we had them suggest a new skin. You can check it out for yourself with the code “FRACTAL” once you download this patch.

Patch Notes
Additional loot has been added! (Tool Box, Ice Cream Hat #1, and Wooden Wand pictured)
Sound options have been expanded into a Sound Menu that lets users adjust sound and music levels to their choosing
Bug that rewarded additional fragments in specific situations fixed
Bug where buttons would not reappear in Sportsball on second victory fixed
Loot Box sprite not being shown in Loot Box Farming fixed

notes.title: Beta 0.2.3 Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33146644/7a62036bb072c988977ad88a4562a4c926c48dbf.png
This has been an awesome week for us with the Steam launch last Friday! It’s been really exciting watching people playing literally all around the globe!
Patch Notes
The number of achievements completed is now saved (if you are loading an old save it will update this number as you load in)
The number of boxes crafted is now saved
Incorrect time-played metric removed
Inventory item description box now in line with Opened Loot Display’s so will show what sets an item belongs to
Buttons in Sportsball will only show after the player’s Grand Sanctum is struck twice
Pieces on board in 1DChess update as soon as a piece begins moving


Tweaks
Hard to Open Loot Box prompt grammar adjusted
Tutorial achievement text adjusted for clarity
Tutorial now has a preamble to provide context before giving player items
